identity.title: [C-SDLC v2] Add typed STP deliverable correction after review recovery

values.task_boundary: Implement, prove, review, and publish the narrow post-recovery STP deliverable correction; stop before merge unless explicitly authorized.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A recovered implemented issue can correct only its STP deliverables through csdlc-edit apply.
AC-2: An implemented issue without typed review recovery cannot use the operation.
AC-3: Every non-implemented phase and every non-STP card rejects the operation.
AC-4: Stale CAS, projection drift, blank values, and duplicate values fail closed.
AC-5: The atomic commit preserves unrelated STP fields and regenerates all projections and digests.
AC-6: Durable audit evidence includes actor, reason, previous deliverables, and replacements.
AC-7: Focused tests, formatting, strict Clippy, and installation proof pass from /Volumes/FastWork.
AC-8: Issue #73 successfully consumes the installed operation without direct card edits.
dependencies: Existing csdlc-edit atomic store and projection validation
non_goals: Phase rollback from implemented to bound
